queries.query: Pleiku Viet Nam official cadastral parcel map cadastre GIS Gia Lai
queries.result: First-party discovery located the official Pleiku ward portal and the national General Department of Land Administration (GDLA) land-inventory map. The Pleiku portal provides land-related public information and links to land procedures, but no anonymous parcel feature service was exposed. The GDLA map is public as a viewer, while cadastral feature/detail routes require login.

queries.query: Pleiku Gia Lai bản đồ địa chính thửa đất cổng thông tin chính thức
queries.result: First-party Vietnamese discovery confirmed the official Pleiku portal, its land-information collection activity, and the GDLA map system. Official material identifies the Pleiku land-registration branch as the custodian involved in cadastral extracts, but the public map application returned a login response for anonymous cadastral feature and feature-detail requests. No parcel polygon was retained.

registryEvidence.localCustodian: Official Pleiku portal material identifies the municipal/ward land administration process and the Văn phòng đăng ký đất đai tỉnh Gia Lai - Chi nhánh Pleiku as the cadastral-registration branch involved in cadastral-map extracts. The official portal also documents collection of land-user information for the national land database.
registryEvidence.officialPublicMap: The GDLA national land-map viewer at maps.gdla.gov.vn is an official public map application. Its public configuration exposes land-use categories and map-layer configuration, but cadastral feature data is not anonymous.
